name: Single-Pass GPU Ray Casting with Spherical Textures
aliases: GPU Ray Casting (Single Pass) with Spherical 3D Textures
Single-pass GPU ray casting with 3D textures in spherical coordinates
definition: A single-pass volume rendering technique that stores a 3D dataset in spherical coordinates as a 3D texture, then performs ray marching in a fragment shader to sample, apply a transfer function, and alpha-composite the volume along rays cast from the camera.
summary: Single-Pass GPU Ray Casting with Spherical Textures renders 3D volumes in spherical coordinates by mapping data to a 3D texture and performing ray marching in a fragment shader, differing from standard methods by requiring coordinate transformations to address geometric distortion.
